integrity: All mathematical assertions presented as new are accompanied by a complete proof and finite exact checks; finite enumeration is not treated as proof of the infinite family. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The inversion semidirect product is required to have a nontrivial finite abelian kernel; other involutory actions and nonabelian kernels are not treated. Cyclic-kernel values are established in prior literature. Possible implicit coverage in broader subgroup-lattice theory remains a residual originality risk.
title: Maximal-subgroup incidence spectra of generalized dihedral groups
